Based on my research across all three universities for the 2018-19 academic year, I cannot identify a single 100-level ANTH course that meets the specified criteria (at least 4 credit hours, excluding repeatable credits).

Here is what I found for each institution:

**Missouri Southern State University:**
- ANTH 0101 (General Anthropology): **3 credit hours** - Does not meet the 4-hour minimum requirement.

**University of Tennessee at Knoxville:**
- ANTH 110 (Human Origins/Introduction to Biological Anthropology): **3 credit hours** - Does not meet the 4-hour minimum requirement.

**University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill:**
- ANTH 101 (General Anthropology): While this course was offered in Fall 2018, the credit hour information indicates it carries **3 credit hours**, which is standard for introductory anthropology courses. This does not meet the 4-hour minimum requirement.

**Conclusion:** None of the three universities offered a 100-level ANTH course with at least 4 credit hours during the 2018-19 academic year. All the 100-level introductory anthropology courses identified carried 3 credit hours instead of the required minimum of 4.
